{{Quote|Colonel Lenora Trazen, Imperial Four-Hundred-Twenty-Fifth Special Infantry.|Lenora Trazen|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Lenora Trazen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] and a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. As part of the [[Four-Hundred-Twenty-Fifth Special Infantry]], she led the operations during the [[Dantooine Incursion]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Trazen is a character from ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. She first appeared as the Imperial contact for "The Pirate Incursion" event on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. She can be flirted with by players of either [[Gender/Legends|sex]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
